title: A formal framework for higher-order spin models via hypergraphs, polymatroids, and the Tutte polynomial
summary: We develop a rigorous mathematical framework for statistical mechanics models on hypergraphs, and give conditions for lifting the classical connection between Potts model partition functions and the Tutte polynomial from graphs to hypergraphs. We define hypergraphical models and their associated partition functions, and extend these to special classes of models induced by families of interaction functions.
